title: New Line labels its fields Title and Description, with question hints
custom_preconds: 1. You are signed in as a service writer on the build under test, with a work order open.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Line to open the line dialog.
  2. Read the label of the first free-text field and the second.
  3. With both boxes empty, read the placeholder text inside each.
  4. Type a value in each box (e.g. Title "Replace tie rod", Description "excessive play") and watch the placeholder.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The first field is labelled exactly "Title" and the second exactly "Description".
  • While empty, the Title box shows the placeholder "What are you doing?" and the Description box shows "Why are you doing it?"; each placeholder disappears as soon as the box has a value.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
